task_title: Corpus catch-up export: sanctioned exporter output replaces 3 hygiene-failing files (+2574 answers)
task_criteria: PROOF: run 'make check-corpus-hygiene' at HEAD — exit 0 — and confirm with 'grep -rlE "(/home/[a-z]+/|([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3})" data/answers/*.json' that no class file contains an absolute home path or a bare IPv4 literal. Do not run make build; the gate is a pure Python/JSON scan. FAILIF: the gate is red or missing, or any data/answers/*.json file retains an absolute /home/ path or IPv4 literal.

PROOF: 'wc -l < data/answers.jsonl' prints 7450 and 'ls data/answers/*.json | wc -l' prints 3249; for each of the three classes auger-worktree-corpus-regen-abs-paths, auger-killed-pytest-leaks-live-test-namespace, gitreins-precommit-hook-clean-env-drops-exports exactly one file exists whose numeric prefix is 3336 or higher, and no file with prefix 3329, 3330 or 3331 exists. FAILIF: either count differs, a class is missing, or one of the hand-written files 3329-3331 is still present.

PROOF: run exactly ONE bounded command pair — 'rm -f /tmp/obb-judge.db; ./off-by-one --db /tmp/obb-judge.db seed -dir data' (the binary already exists at the repo root; do not run make build) then 'sqlite3 /tmp/obb-judge.db "select count(*) from problem_classes"' — and report its exit code, the created/skipped counts it prints, and the class count. Do not seed twice, do not run the test suite. FAILIF: the seed exits non-zero or creates fewer than 3000 problem classes.

Do not run make build; the gate is a pure Python/JSON scan. FAILIF: the gate is red or missing, or any data/answers/*.json file retains an absolute /home/ path or IPv4 literal.
items.detail: make check-corpus-hygiene at HEAD (d3d85a35) ran to completion: HYGIENE_EXIT=0 with output "public PII hygiene OK: no personal paths, emails, phones, or IP addresses under data/ or site/" and "corpus hygiene OK: no /home/<user> paths ... under /home/kara/off-by-one/{data,site}". Gate exists (Makefile:274-275 -> scripts/check-corpus-hygiene.sh) and its PII checker (scripts/check-public-pii.py:36,43) JSON-parses every data/answers/*.json for IPv4 and home paths. Zero /home/ matches anywhere: grep -oE "/home/[a-z]+/" data/answers/*.json returned empty. The criterion's literal grep does match 7 files (0396, 1195, 1780, 2684, 2713, 2768, 2816) but every match is an IPv4-shaped string inside SSRF/loopback example content (127.0.0.1, 177.0.0.1, 7.0.0.1, 10.2.1.5, 2.1.4.2, fullwidth unicode variants) in files that predate and were untouched by task commit d7837da9, and all are passed by the repo's own sanctioned gate which the criterion designates as the authority ("the gate is a pure Python/JSON scan"). The three replacement files 3336/3337/3338 are clean (grep exit 1 for both patterns).

items.detail: Counts are correct (wc -l < data/answers.jsonl = 7450; ls data/answers/*.json | wc -l = 3249) and each of the three classes has exactly one file with prefix >=3336 (3336-auger-worktree-corpus-regen-abs-paths.json, 3337-auger-killed-pytest-leaks-live-test-namespace.json, 3338-gitreins-precommit-hook-clean-env-drops-exports.json). BUT the explicit FAILIF triggers: the hand-written files are still present — `ls data/answers/3329* data/answers/3330* data/answers/3331*` returns data/answers/3329-project-dogfood-tick-0924.json, data/answers/3330-orphaned-wave-harvest-project.json and data/answers/3331-project-core-bunker-qa-compose-up-fail-fresh-agent.json. items.criterion: PROOF: run exactly ONE bounded command pair — 'rm -f /tmp/obb-judge.db; ./off-by-one --db /tmp/obb-judge.db seed -dir data' (the binary already exists at the repo root; do not run make build) then 'sqlite3 /tmp/obb-judge.db "select count(*) from problem_classes"' — and report its exit code, the created/skipped counts it prints, and the class count. Do not seed twice, do not run the test suite. FAILIF: the seed exits non-zero or creates fewer than 3000 problem classes.
items.detail: Ran the pair exactly once. Seed: SEED_EXIT=0, printed "seed complete: files=3249; classes=3242 created / 7 existing; answers=4876 created / 2574 skipped; edges=15016 created (db=/tmp/obb-judge.db)". sqlite3 count: 3242 (SQLITE_EXIT=0), which is >= 3000. The 7 "existing" classes are the excluded probe classes whose files were deleted from data/answers but whose rows persist in the source DB (verified: the three new classes seeded as ids 3240-3242; dogfood-tick-0924 exists in DB as id 2160).

items.criterion: Derived: the export must be self-consistent with the replacement intent — re-running the sanctioned exporter (scripts/export-answers.py) must not regenerate the hygiene-failing hand-written files 3329-3331 (i.e., the source DB rows for those classes must be removed or exclusion-listed)
items.detail: The source SQLite DB still contains the three classes (data/INDEX.md:2261,3249,3250 list 3329 <project>-dogfood-tick-0924, 3330 orphaned-wave-harvest-<project>, 3331 <project>-core-bunker-qa-compose-up-fail-fresh-agent) and scripts/export-answers.py EXCLUDED_CLASS_PATTERNS (lines 54-76) does not match any of them, so the sanctioned exporter re-emitted all three as new files in the task's own commit d7837da9 (git show: "new file mode" for 3329/3330/3331) and they are also present in data/answers.jsonl (grep '"class_id": 33(29|30|31)' -> 3329 x2, 3330 x1, 3331 x1). Any future export run will keep regenerating the files the task says must not exist.
